decision_rule: SIGNAL_SUPPORTED if on seed 11 the frozen feature has AUROC >= .70 for C3-alone failure and the 95 % bootstrap lower bound (2000 resamples, seed 11) is > .50. POLICY_SUPPORTED if on seed 11 the frozen policy passes at least 3 net more tasks than C3 alone (paired) AND at least as many as the shipped heuristic (Thread G rule). Otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED for that part. No runtime change either way.
